name: Issue 7728: Power Overwhelming resets Runic Brand at level 48 through the Runic specialization
contract: Power Overwhelming 707876 is the Runic specialization's level 40 passive (CharacterAdvancement 4802): 'Your
Runeblade and Primordial Blast now have a 35% chance to grant you Power Overwhelming, resetting the cooldown of
Runic Brand.' The report came from a level 48 Runemaster. At that level the class kit grants Runeblade rank 9
573445 and Runic Brand rank 5 712304, so the talent is reached through the specialization choice, not a learn.
Each trial casts Runic Brand, Runeblade, then Runic Brand again 2.6 sec later, inside its 12 sec cooldown: the
second cast lands only when Runeblade's proc cast 561055 reset it. Thirty trials at 35% give 1 to 23 resets
outside a 3e-6 tail and as many extra Runic Brands. A level 48 Runemaster without the specialization never
resets and casts exactly one Runic Brand per trial.
